annotation.bound_parties_text: The Communication is a non-binding strategy that sets out Commission intentions and recommendations to Member States, EASA and stakeholders, without imposing binding obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The Commission intends to adopt amendments to the Standardised European Rules of the Air and the Air Traffic Management/Air Navigation Services Regulation
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ‘A Drone Strategy 2.0 for a Smart and Sustainable Unmanned Aircraft Eco-System in Europe’
